hero.intro_en: Write the first draft of your resume in U.S. format: clear sections, your most recent job first, and achievements with numbers. It becomes Part 4 of your Capstone.
hero.intro_es: Escribe el primer borrador de tu currículum en formato de EE. UU.: secciones claras, tu trabajo más reciente primero y logros con números. Se convierte en la Parte 4 de tu Capstone.

parts.es: Tu nombre y datos de contacto

hint.en: City and state, phone, email and LinkedIn. No photo or date of birth.
hint.es: Ciudad y estado, teléfono, correo y LinkedIn. Sin foto ni fecha de nacimiento.

hint.en: 2 lines: who you are, your years of experience and your strengths. No “I”.
hint.es: 2 líneas: quién eres, tus años de experiencia y tus fortalezas. Sin “I”.

parts.example: Bilingual HR professional with 6 years of experience in recruiting…
phrases: [Job title] with [number] years of experience in [field].

hint.en: Title, company, city and dates. Most recent job first.
hint.es: Cargo, empresa, ciudad y fechas. El trabajo más reciente primero.

parts.example: HR Coordinator | Grupo Industrial Bajío | Aguascalientes, MX | 2021–2025

hint.en: Start with an action verb and add a result, with a number if you can.
hint.es: Empieza con un verbo de acción y agrega un resultado, con un número si puedes.

parts.example: • Hired 120+ production employees and cut time to hire…

hint.en: Degree, school, city and year. Add certifications if you have them.
hint.es: Título, escuela, ciudad y año. Agrega certificaciones si las tienes.

parts.example: B.A. in Business Administration, Universidad Autónoma de Aguascalientes – 2019

hint.en: Languages with level, software and key skills from the job ad.
hint.es: Idiomas con nivel, software y habilidades clave del anuncio de empleo.

rules.d_en: Section headings, short bullets, one or two pages.
rules.d_es: Títulos por sección, viñetas cortas, una o dos páginas.

rules.d_en: Start each bullet with an action verb; add a number.
rules.d_es: Empieza cada viñeta con un verbo de acción; agrega un número.

rules.t_es: Formato de currículum de EE. UU.
rules.d_en: No photo, age, marital status or “I”.
rules.d_es: Sin foto, edad, estado civil ni “I”.

example.subject: Resume – Ana Pérez
paragraphs: Bilingual HR professional with 6 years of experience in recruiting and onboarding for manufacturing companies. Skilled in high-volume hiring, employee records and benefits enrollment.
HR Coordinator | Grupo Industrial Bajío | Aguascalientes, MX | 2021–2025
• Hired 120+ production employees in one year and cut the average time to hire from 30 to 18 days
• Designed a 5-day onboarding program for new hires
Recruiting Assistant | Talento Norte | Monterrey, MX | 2019–2021
• Screened 50+ resumes a week and scheduled interviews for 8 hiring managers
• Digitized 900 employee files and cut search time by half
B.A. in Business Administration, Universidad Autónoma de Aguascalientes – 2019

✍️ Writing Task – Week 4

Title: First Draft of Your U.S.-Style Resume
Estimated Time: 1–2 Hours
Goal: Turn your work history into a clear, results-focused U.S.-style resume and prepare Capstone Part 4.

Syllabus line (Week 4):
Week 4 – Human Resources & Hiring
The hiring process, onboarding, employee benefits
Capstone Part 4: Your work history in resume form
Reading: Sample resumes and job ads
Writing: First draft of your U.S.-style resume
Speaking: 1-minute pitch about your career goals

Instructions (CelsU):
Write the first draft of your resume with: your name and contact information, a short professional summary, your recent jobs (title, company, city, dates) in reverse chronological order, 2 achievements per job (action verb + result, with numbers if you can), your education and certifications, and your skills and languages. 150–350 words. No photo, age, marital status or “I”.

Semana 4 – Recursos Humanos y Contratación
El proceso de contratación, la incorporación (onboarding) y las prestaciones para empleados
Capstone Parte 4: Tu historial laboral en forma de currículum

Sin foto, edad, estado civil ni “I”.
